decision: Adopt the signal table and all fourteen explicit default dispositions in OSC-ES-1.
rationale: No inferred Eurorack conformance, no jack normalization, no qualified electrical values.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: Audio/CV/indicator use OPA4196IDR; precision uses OPA4197IPWR. Roles are data references with explicit package contracts.
rationale: Reject TL074 everywhere for current; reject TL074H/OPA4171 on the bulk roles because even this lower-current model exceeds -12 V ceiling.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: ADG5412FBRUZ source-facing isolation on all inputs; 998 ohm output isolation in two 499 ohm 0.5 W resistors; dual feedback for precision.
rationale: Bare input rail clamps can phantom-power rails; 100–470 ohm precision isolation increases fault current. Bench qualification remains open.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: 92 one-opamp bridge magnitude drivers, 12 current-source stage drivers, 10 buffered analog window detectors.
rationale: Do not place any lamp driver on a hold/timing/storage node; do not route negative-rail comparator outputs to logic.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: 47 attenuverters and four audio levels stay 10 kohm behind buffers; 48 DC sources become 100 kohm; two slew pots stay 500 kohm.
rationale: Reject direct 10 kohm jack loading and 48 mA reference-pot load; preserve Bourns PTV09A-4020F mechanics.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: REF5050AIDR with buffered ±5 V, locally buffered octave ladder and bounded harness contract; declare local timing islands.
rationale: No raw ladder, summing node, timing capacitor or storage node may cross a board connector.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: Factory-fitted SMD trimmers with end-strapped wipers and bounded ranges; measured load and octave error targets.
rationale: No owner soldering; 0.1% individual resistors do not certify pitch accuracy.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: 100 nF per supply pin, 4.7 uF per board rail, total 150/150/100 uF nominal ceilings; current ceilings stay 960/640/400 mA.
rationale: Negative rail estimate is 712.655 mA; #34 must remove at least 72.655 mA through explicit circuit/role decisions before partition. Startup remains unqualified.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

decision: Use parts-shortlist.json as the downstream design selection; unknown stock/factory routes remain UNVERIFIED.
rationale: No component owner promotion or order BOM; #15 retains exact data, #21 promotes evidence, #34 replaces count estimates.
status: accepted for draft capture; not hardware qualification

topic: G06 filter GAIN and RES behavior
decision: GAIN changes unprocessed OUT volume only; LP/BP/HP remain independent of GAIN in the intended signal paths; RES controls their shared filter resonance.
rationale: Explicit user ok confirms the existing parallel dry VCA and independent filter-tap behavior. Historical proposal and owner-confirmation-pending records are superseded only for this behavior choice.
status: behavior confirmed; circuit and physical qualification remain open; no hardware or manufacturing adoption
scope: Documentation, source comments and decision metadata only; no connection, component, value, package, topology or code-behavior change.

decision: D3-A: revised zudo-pd path at 20 V / 5 A (USB-PD 20 V PDO, Board P plus Board B change) with a 5 A e-marked cable supplies OSC through OSC-EXT-PWR-8-R1. The OSC contract (continuous, 20 ms transient, maximum, source bands, ripple, capacitance, startup) is unchanged.
rationale: Only option in the record meeting both continuous and transient delivery rows on paper; the 15 V / 3 A Board B cannot carry the contract (R5). Gates stay open: TVS2200 vs STUSB4500 clamp margin (L7, blocking), interface-maximum limiter, reverse blocking and all-rail shutdown (R7, G3, G4), efficiency, ripple and source bands (L6, G6, G7).
status: decision confirmed; PD-side design, circuit and physical qualification remain open; no hardware or manufacturing adoption

decision: D5-1: no degraded mode. Full OSC runs only on a supply contract that meets the OSC table; otherwise no rail is enabled (accept or refuse). The usage-limit re-basing (D5-2) and switchable power domains (D5-3) are not adopted.
rationale: OSC demand is mostly fixed quiescent and resistor current in one EXT domain, so a supply-side limit yields brownout, which the no-partial-supply fault policy forbids. Requires contract detection before enable and all-rail shutdown on renegotiation, lower contract, removal or brownout (G12, PD-003 L2).
status: decision confirmed; contract detection and all-rail shutdown circuit (#59, G12) and physical qualification remain open; no hardware or manufacturing adoption
